question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The documents indicate that pitch is not the only factor affecting out-of-key converted singing; the quality of conversion depends on the joint representation of phonetic and pitch information, and the difficulty in learning this joint representation can lead to out-of-key results even when pitch is not the direct cause.
